consequence.statement: Ingress resources defined with the networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 API version will no longer be recognized or processed by Traefik v3.
consequence.remediation: Update all Ingress resource definitions to use the networking.k8s.io/v1 API version.

original.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.

decision.reason: [ev-f3d6519c3794] says that in v3, support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 "has been removed" and that operators should use networking.k8s.io/v1 instead. When support is removed, Ingress resources an operator defines under v1beta1 stop being honoured by Traefik, so setting-ignored with action-required class fits. The proposed remediation repeats the guide's instruction. The text does not spell out the exact runtime behaviour, such as whether those resources are silently skipped or logged, so confidence is low.
